about: The closure runner's own child reaper preserves the helper's status, reaps other ended children, and does not wait on running children. The focused killer observes child-exit events before checking ended-child reaping. Every mutated line is in a _test.go file, which the cover tool does not instrument, so each row names its killers in anchor.tests.

mutants.name: gs23-recorded-run-ignored
mutants.rule: A run's deadline cost is at least its package's slowest recorded sweep run.

mutants.name: gs23-build-not-a-run
mutants.rule: The build of the test binary counts as a run of the sweep: its bound is the slowest run's.

mutants.name: gs23-sweep-is-the-slowest-run
mutants.rule: The recorded sweep is the package's whole sweep, not its slowest run.

mutants.name: b15-r8-closure-skips-ended-child
mutants.rule: An ended non-helper child is reaped, not left as a zombie.

mutants.name: b15-r8-closure-steals-helper-status
mutants.rule: The helper's exec.Cmd remains the sole wait owner of its exit status.

mutants.name: rm-cgo-link-input
mutants.from: {"-lc", file, "GNU ld's cwd lookup while the Go toolchain links a cgo dependency"},
mutants.rule: A real cgo linker cwd input belongs to the toolchain inputs; observation and cache hashing must remain enabled.

mutants.name: g16fix2-alone-shares-a-run
mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. A test of runsAlone (it runs its package again) holds a sweep run of its own.

mutants.name: g16fix2-alone-runs-twice
mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. The last run of the other tests skips the tests run alone, so each test runs once.

mutants.name: g16fix2-sweep-ignores-alone
mutants.from: return planPackage(names, costs, sweepRunBudget, runsAlone[dir]), nil
mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. The sweep's plan gives each runsAlone test (cmd/ergo's TestPackageNeverWritesUnderHome) a run of its own.

mutants.name: g16fix2-stale-alone-accepted
mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. A runsAlone name that is not a test of its package fails the sweep.

mutants.name: g16fix2-seed-skips-entries
mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. seedCache places every entry of the store.

mutants.name: g16fix2-store-cgo-on
mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. The store's builds run no C linker, whose cwd lookups are declared inputs (everyPackage) the store would hide.

mutants.name: g16fix2-store-goroot-in-checkout
mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. A GOROOT inside the checkout is refused: its compiles would hide inputs.

mutants.name: g16fix2-store-built-in-checkout
mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. The store's builds run outside the checkout.

mutants.name: g16fix2-store-other-toolchain
mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. The store is built by the toolchain the checkout selects.

mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. A complete store is reused, not built again.

mutants.name: g16fix2-store-writable
mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. The store's files are read-only, so no run changes an entry through its link.

mutants.name: g16fix2-store-keeps-stale
mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. A fill removes the stores of other toolchains, so the store directory does not grow.

mutants.name: gf3-run-deadline-from-wall
mutants.rule: A swept run's deadline reads the CPU its tests record, not only their wall.

mutants.name: gf3-run-deadline-ignores-cost
mutants.rule: A swept run's deadline is ten times its recorded cost, not a fixed bound.

mutants.name: sweep-unmeasured-floored
mutants.rule: A swept run holding a test with no recorded time is bounded only by the test binary's deadline, not the 30 minute floor.

mutants.name: sweep-unmeasured-hang-floored
mutants.rule: An unmeasured run's cost sets no bound of its own.

mutants.name: gatesandbox-std-store-under-tmpdir
mutants.rule: A sweep given ERGO_CLOSURE_STD_DIR shares that std store and builds nothing, whatever its TMPDIR. The edited file is a test file, which coverage does not instrument.

mutants.name: closure-hang-progress-ignored
mutants.rule: A run's progress moves its quiet window: a run that keeps working is not stopped at a fixed bound (cmd/ergo's 58-61 minute runs).

mutants.name: closure-hang-end-ignored
mutants.rule: A run that keeps working is stopped at the end this test binary's deadline leaves it, so the sweep reports its verdicts.

mutants.name: closure-hang-quiet-ignored
mutants.rule: A run that makes no progress for its quiet window is stopped.

mutants.name: sweep-deadline-cpu-ignored
mutants.from: progress: func() int64 { return progress() + treeCPU(pid)<<40 },
mutants.rule: A swept run that computes without output is making progress: the sweep stops a run only when it stops using CPU and writing.

mutants.name: sweep-deadline-cpu-leader-only
mutants.rule: A run's CPU is that of every process of the run, not only its leader's.

mutants.name: heavy-cost2-reuse-env-unchecked
mutants.to: if diff := envDifference(rec.Env, env); false && diff != "" {
mutants.rule: A recorded run whose environment differs from a swept run's (a tier variable, another value) is not reused.

mutants.name: heavy-cost2-reuse-coverage-unchecked
mutants.rule: Recorded runs are reused only when together they ran every test of the package.

mutants.name: heavy-cost2-reuse-userns-unchecked
mutants.rule: A recorded run that could make user namespaces (the sweep's S3) is not reused.

mutants.name: heavy-cost2-reuse-cache-unchecked
mutants.rule: A recorded run that built in a cache other packages share is not reused (TestSharedCacheKeepsEachPackagesInputs).

mutants.name: heavy-cost2-reuse-short-run
mutants.rule: A -short run skipped the tests that build Go, so it does not stand for the sweep's run.
